THE_ARCHITECT.talk.JANUS_SPIRE2_CHARACTE:
[sine]It's all right, Janus... Start with a proper greeting.[/sine]
H-hello, Mr. Architect. I'm Janus, a Royal Navy destroyer. Do you... know how I can get back to my port?
Continue
Your port? You climbed all this way just to go home?
Answer
Yes... The Commander, Jervis, everyone... they're all there. I'd searched everywhere I could before coming to the Spire... I don't want them to keep worrying about me.
Continue
I built the Spire. Not your way home.
Ask Again

[sine]I'm sorry to trouble you...[/sine]
But even the smallest clue would help. The Commander is still back at port... I want to be by his side again.
Continue
The one you seek is not here. Back to the bottom with you.
Architect
Mr. Architect, I'm s-sorry to bother you again... I wrote down all the routes that didn't work in my diary. Could you... please tell me how to get back to port this time?
Continue
A few pages will find you an exit?
Explain
I-I know a diary isn't enough... But I don't want to forget the paths I've taken, or my port. Someday, I want to turn to the page where I found my way home and show the Commander myself.
Continue
Your voice is shaking. And still you mean to go on?
Find Your Courage

[sine]Y-yes... I'm still scared.[/sine]
But I don't want them to wait for someone who never comes home. As long as there's somewhere I haven't searched... I'll try again.
Continue
Then take your little book and start over.
Architect
JANUS_SPIRE2_EVENT_QUEEN_ELIZABETH.title: Queen Elizabeth
I am Queen Elizabeth, flagship of the Royal Navy's super-dreadnoughts. Has a commoner come before me? No...?
It cannot compare to the joy of receiving a gift from the Commander, but I'll gladly accept it.
Go and claim your reward. Warspite, show her the way.
Take your pick from these dreary tributes.
Take these and dispose of those wretches!
What are you waiting for? Continue your adventure.
Well... Consider this a token of my favor...
